svg.title: Location Tracker
svg.desc: The app's own mark: a ping. The same orange as the page's `accent` on the same near black as its dark `surface-1`, so the icon and the page it opens read as one thing. The rings are the halo layers.js draws around the newest fix. All of the art sits inside a radius of 155, well within the 204.8 maskable safe zone, which is what lets the same drawing serve both purposes. Source of truth for the PNGs beside it; see icons/render.py.
